summary: Backend dashboard features testing complete. All 30 tests passed. Verified all 19 requested features: Orders (POST/GET/reveal), Wallet, Tickets (CRUD + poll), Admin tickets, and Telegram webhook integration with 2-way messaging.

backend_passed: POST /api/webhook/social-reply WITH secret but text missing ticket ID returns ok + ignored=no_ticket_id
POST /api/webhook/social-reply for non-existent ticket returns ok + ignored=ticket_not_found
POST /api/webhook/social-reply with no text returns ok + ignored=no_text
POST /api/orders creates order with dummy credentials + warranty based on is_trusted
GET /api/orders returns user's orders list (credentials excluded)
POST /api/orders/{id}/reveal returns credentials and increments reveals_count
POST /api/orders/{id}/reveal for another user's order returns 404
POST /api/tickets creates ticket with seq ID, messages[0] is user msg, status=open
GET /api/admin/tickets returns all tickets + counts (requires admin)
POST /api/webhook/social-reply WITH secret + '#seq message' parses ticket, appends admin message, sets status=pending_user
POST /api/webhook/social-reply WITH secret + 'seq: message' format also parsed correctly
Webhook messages appear in ticket thread with source=telegram

orders.create: Creates order with dummy credentials (login, password, email, email_password, notes)
orders.warranty_logic: 7 days if is_trusted_seller (extended_guarantee>0 OR origin in personal/autoreg OR nsb==1), else 0 days

tickets.create: Creates ticket with TKT-{seq:04d} format, seq from db.counters collection
tickets.get: Returns full thread with all messages
tickets.poll: Returns new_messages since timestamp, status, last_activity, total

admin_tickets.list: Returns all tickets + counts (open, pending_user, closed)

webhook.message_append: Appends admin message with source=telegram, sets status=pending_user

critical_code_review_comments: All dashboard endpoints properly protected with authentication
Webhook security correctly implemented with secret header validation
Ticket seq numbering uses db.counters collection for atomic increment
Credentials properly excluded from order list view but available via reveal endpoint
Warranty logic correctly implements is_trusted_seller check (extended_guarantee, origin, nsb)
test_credentials: Test users created dynamically via pymongo in test fixtures, cleaned up after tests
seed_data_creation: Test users, sessions, orders, tickets created and cleaned up in test fixtures
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard backend features fully verified. Key findings: (1) Orders endpoint creates mock orders with dummy credentials and warranty based on is_trusted_seller logic, (2) Wallet returns balance_usd=0 by default with empty transactions, (3) Tickets use sequential IDs from db.counters collection, (4) Telegram webhook requires secret header and supports '#seq' and 'seq:' message formats, (5) Admin chat check bypassed when TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID is placeholder. All existing endpoints (/api/auth/me, /api/market/search/*, /api/stats/live) remain intact.
mocked_api_note: Telegram outbound sendMessage is MOCKED (logs only) when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN='YOUR_BOT_TOKEN_HERE' (placeholder). Inbound webhook is fully functional.
